def decide(bars, account):
    """Slow trend filter with a 2% tolerance band around the 200-day MA: buy only when close is 2% above the MA, sell only when close is 2% below it, so shallow crossings inside the band do not trigger whipsaw trades."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 200:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for 200-day average"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma200 = sum(closes[-200:]) / 200
    upper = ma200 * 1.02
    lower = ma200 * 0.98
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > upper:
            return "BUY", "close more than 2% above 200-day average (confirmed uptrend)"
        return "HOLD", "inside or below band, stay flat"
    if price < lower:
        return "SELL", "close more than 2% below 200-day average (trend broken)"
    return "HOLD", "holding inside or above band"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Stay long by default to capture the uptrend that drives buy&hold; exit only on a confirmed breakdown (close below 50-day MA and 20-day MA below 50-day MA) or an 8% trailing stop from the peak close since entry."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for 20/50-day averages"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma20 = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma50:
            return "BUY", "close above 50-day average (stay long in uptrend)"
        return "HOLD", "no uptrend"
    entry = account.get("entry_price")
    peak = price
    if entry is not None:
        peak = max(entry, price)
        for c in closes[-60:]:
            if c > peak:
                peak = c
    if price < ma50 and ma20 < ma50:
        return "SELL", "confirmed breakdown: close below 50-day and 20-day below 50-day"
    if peak > 0 and price < peak * 0.92:
        return "SELL", "8% trailing stop from peak close since entry"
    return "HOLD", "holding while trend intact and within trailing stop"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Trend-following with a slower exit: enter when close is above the 20-day average and the 20-day average is above the 50-day average; exit when close falls below the 50-day average or the position is 12% below its peak close since entry."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for 20/50-day averages"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma20 = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma20 and ma20 > ma50:
            return "BUY", "close above 20-day average and 20-day above 50-day (trend aligned)"

    if price < ma50:

        return "SELL", "12% trailing stop from peak close since entry"
    return "HOLD", "holding while above 50-day average and within trailing stop"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Trend-following: hold while close is above the 20-day average; exit only when close is below both the 20- and 50-day averages; enter only when the 20-day average is above the 50-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for 20/50-day averages"
    price = closes[-1]

    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma20 and ma20 > ma50:
            return "BUY", "close above 20-day average and 20-day above 50-day (trend aligned)"
        return "HOLD", "no confirmed uptrend"
    if price < ma20 and price < ma50:
        return "SELL", "close below both 20- and 50-day averages"
    return "HOLD", "holding through shallow dip"

Starting strategy supplied by the researcher and identical for every run; you did not write it. It is deliberately simple. Judge it on the evidence like any other version.
def decide(bars, account):
    """Seed strategy: hold the stock while its close is above the 20-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 20:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    price = closes[-1]
    if account["position"] <= 0 and price > average:
        return "BUY", "close is above the 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and price < average:
        return "SELL", "close is below the 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"
